image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, textured rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) surrounded by a thick, hairy/spiny girdle. The background consists of encrusted rock with pink and grey hues.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are clearly surrounded by a thick peripheral band (girdle) which exhibits a fuzzy/hairy texture, fitting the 'hairy' variant description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates show a mottled greyish-brown coloration with subtle textural variations, consistent with natural chiton appearance.
